note: Written by the analysts. Each rule is a list of conditions on account features that must all hold. 'weight' is the analysts' starting log-odds for the rule; the nightly refit starts from it and moves only as far as verdicts justify.

rules.description: Average fill price more than 80 bps off the index on more than $20,000 of decayed 24-hour notional
Half or more of 24-hour fill notional against one counterparty, on more than $10,000
Withdrew most of what was deposited within 90 minutes of the deposit
Three or more devices in seven days
Account under seven days old with more than $50,000 of decayed 24-hour notional
